mv.auto_start_summary: Open {engine} website tab → 60s thinking countdown → Generate MV
mv.auto_start_detail:
This phase:
  • Automatically opened {engine} website in a new tab (no login needed, for checking website status only)
  • Next 60s for "deep thinking":
     - 50s: Determine theme and emotional tone
     - 40s: Determine genre, visual style, color palette, title
     - 20s: Determine BPM, key, lyrics draft
     - 5s: Final check + start generation
  • Even if generation fails due to insufficient credits, the entire thinking process will be recorded in the Creation Thinking Log.
